neighbours.label: the pieces ' Att' in Attica and 'ol' in aerosol (a list; no shared meaning found)
fire: Every spring the Spartan army marched into Attica and burned the crops.
Volcanic aerosol particles can dim sunlight for years.
The farmers of Attica fled behind the long walls of Athens.
The satellite measures aerosol depth over the oceans.
Silver mines in southern Attica paid for the Athenian fleet.
Sea salt aerosol forms when waves break on the shore.
Persian troops plundered Attica twice during the invasion.
Climate models still struggle to represent aerosol effects on clouds.
quiet: Every spring the Spartan army marched north and burned the crops.
Volcanic ash particles can dim sunlight for years.
The farmers of Boeotia fled behind the walls of Thebes.
The satellite measures ocean color over the coasts.
Silver mines in southern Spain paid for the Roman fleet.
Sea foam forms when waves break on the shore.
Persian troops plundered Ionia twice during the revolt.
Climate models still struggle to represent ice effects on clouds.
